subject.title: Hosted Molty (usemolty.com): model selector doesn't persist — API always receives dotted id claude-opus-4.8[Błąd]:

question: Should this issue be owned as a hosted Molty deployment/state repair, a source bug in the shared UI/gateway model-selection path, or an external hosted-service issue outside this repo?
rationale: Current main’s shared UI/gateway path appears to use canonical provider-qualified model ids, but the reporter can only reproduce the failure on hosted usemolty.com without CLI/config access, so maintainer ownership of the deployed path is needed before automation can safely repair it.

options.title: Inspect hosted Molty path
options.body: A hosted owner checks the deployed Brain & Keys request payload, stored session/workspace state, and catalog version, then files or lands the specific repair in the owning repo/path.

options.title: Queue source repair after proof
options.body: If hosted inspection shows the checked-in UI/gateway path is still responsible, convert this to a focused source bug with a current-main repro and validation path.

options.title: Close as external hosted issue
options.body: If usemolty.com is not maintained from this repository and no OpenClaw API seam is missing, redirect the reporter to the hosted service owner with the gathered evidence.

recommendation.title: Inspect hosted Molty path
recommendation.body: A hosted owner checks the deployed Brain & Keys request payload, stored session/workspace state, and catalog version, then files or lands the specific repair in the owning repo/path.

likelyOwner.reason: The most concrete related merged history is PR #87890 adding Opus 4.8 provider/catalog support, and that area overlaps the reported invalid Anthropic model id symptom.
